counterparty.quote: This sub-lease is entered into between Kloof Storage (Pty) Ltd (sample) ("the Sublessor") and Marula Office Supplies (Pty) Ltd ("the Sublessee").

agreementType.quote: This sub-lease is entered into between Kloof Storage (Pty) Ltd (sample)

premises.quote: The Sublessor sub-lets to the Sublessee Unit 12, Kloof Business Yard, Pinetown ("the Premises")

startDate.quote: This sub-lease commences on 1 August 2026 ("the Commencement Date").

endDate.quote: shall vacate on the last day of the sub-lease, leaving the Premises empty

termMonths.quote: The initial term is 24 (twenty-four) months from the Commencement Date.

renewal.quote: This sub-lease renews automatically for successive periods of 12 (twelve) months unless cancelled in terms of clause 5.2.

notice.quote: Either party may cancel this sub-lease by giving the other not less than 90 days written notice before the renewal date.

fee.quote: The monthly rent is R18 500.00 RECEIVED 13 MAR 2026 excluding VAT

feeChange.quote: The rent escalates by 7% (seven percent) on each anniversary of the Commencement Date.

deposit.quote: The Sublessee shall pay a deposit of R37 000.00 on signature of this sub-lease.

scope.value: Use as a warehouse and storage area only
scope.quote: for use as a warehouse and storage area only.
